config.name: Tuya Breaker
config.description: One experimental Ingress workspace for UnTuyaOS3, Lightleak flash backups and Tuya-Cloudcutter, with an isolated Wi-Fi lease

wifi_helper_host.name: WiFi App Helper host
wifi_helper_host.description: Home Assistant host name of the WiFi App Helper. The default fits the official app repository; use local-wifi-helper for a local install. No pairing secret is needed.

run_timeout.name: Session timeout
run_timeout.description: Maximum session duration in seconds, including menu input and connection attempts (60–7200).

wifi_helper_host.name: WiFi-App-Helper-Host
wifi_helper_host.description: Home-Assistant-Hostname des WiFi App Helpers. Der Standard passt zum offiziellen App-Repository; bei lokaler Installation local-wifi-helper verwenden. Ein Kopplungsgeheimnis ist nicht nötig.

run_timeout.name: Zeitlimit der Sitzung
run_timeout.description: Maximale Sitzungsdauer in Sekunden, einschließlich Menüeingabe und Verbindungsversuchen (60–7200).
